minimum_concrete_missing_scenarios.contract: Ordinary-size explicit multiline caption and long name wrapping
minimum_concrete_missing_scenarios.missing_scenario: In a focused UI test reusing `--boarded-ui-fixture`, inject or verify a feed item with explicit newline caption (`"Crux pitch\nSecond attempt"`) and long route name under standard Dynamic Type; assert `app.descendants(matching: .any)["session-post-caption"].frame.height > 20` (greater than single-line 18pt frame) without truncation.

In `BoardedUITests`, resolve `let logBtn = app.buttons["Log"]` and dispatch a tap to coordinate `logBtn.coordinate(withNormalizedOffset: CGVector(dx: 0.5, dy: 0.0)).withOffset(CGVector(dx: 0, dy: -6))`; assert `app.textFields["Venue"].waitForExistence(timeout: 3)` to verify the upper 12pt overhang region actually activates the tab.

In `testRequiredAccessibilityStateCapturesAndDynamicTypeReflow()`, query `app.buttons["Feed"].descendants(matching: .staticText)["Feed"]` and assert `frame.height > 11` to verify `isStandardDynamicType` lifts the fixed 11pt line-box constraint under accessibility content sizes.

ordinary_size_explicit_multiline_caption.evidence: `UITestFixtures.feed` provides single-line short strings only (`caption: "First try, quiet feet."` or `"Six tries. Quiet feet through the crux, then daylight."`, author `"Mara Chen"` / `"Maya K."`, route `"Steep Circuit"` / `"Redpoint Ridge"`). No existing test feeds explicit newlines (`\n`) or wrapping strings into `SessionPostCard.swift` under standard Dynamic Type, leaving the `SingleLineBox` / `MeasuredLineBoxModifier` explicit-newline truncation risk unexercised.

compact_regular_ax_reflow.evidence: `testRequiredAccessibilityStateCapturesAndDynamicTypeReflow` verifies share sheet continuation (`session-facts-continuation`) and vertical stacking under `UICTContentSizeCategoryAccessibilityLarge`, but completely lacks assertions on custom tab bar labels in `RootView.swift` to verify that the standard 11pt fixed frame and -12pt offset are relaxed for Dynamic Type growth.

raised_log_upper_strip_hit_region.evidence: `tab("Log")` in `BoardedUITests.swift` queries `app.buttons.matching(identifier: "Log")` and calls standard `fallback.tap()`. In XCTest, `element.tap()` hits normalized midpoint (0.5, 0.5), landing within the lower 32pt portion inside the tab bar frame. Neither `tab("Log")` nor any other test dispatches a tap into the 12pt upper overhang strip (`y ∈ [-12, 0]` relative to the tab bar top edge) defined by `RaisedButtonHitShape(overhang: 12)`.

cheapest_existing_runtime_scenario.description: Existing XCUITest capture suite launched via `app.launchArguments = ["--boarded-ui-fixture"]` covering standard and accessibilityDynamicType in portrait/landscape on compact (<700pt) and regular (>=700pt) window widths.
